verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a first-party Dashboards product (datadog-docs-12), and community users report that even non-devs can design their own dashboards (datadog-comm-6) and praise distinctive visualizations like the host hexagon map (datadog-comm-17). However, the evidence is only a docs title plus anecdotes, and it never addresses template variables or dashboard sharing. Missing for 10: evidence of template variables, evidence of dashboard sharing (public/shared links), documented breadth of visualization/widget types, and dashboards-as-code support (e.g. API/JSON/Terraform definitions).
